facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Edinburgh's St James Quarter.
facts.excerpt: set in the heart of Edinburgh's St James Quarter

facts.text: W Edinburgh comprises three distinct buildings, two new and one historic.
facts.excerpt: W Edinburgh comprises three distinct buildings, two new and one historic

facts.text: The Ribbon Building is conceived as a bundle of coiled ribbons culminating in a pennant, with bronze-colored metal ribbons that nod to the festival city.
facts.excerpt: Conceived as a bundle of coiled ribbons, culminating in a pennant flying in the Edinburgh breeze, the Ribbon Building is designed to capture the very spirit of festivity. The bronze coloured metal ribbons - a nod to the iconic festival city

facts.text: James Craig Walk is a historic Georgian townhouse terrace dating from 1775, with a stone facade, high ceilings and tall sash windows.
facts.excerpt: Originally a terrace of townhouses dating from 1775, James Craig Walk epitomises the character of historic Edinburgh, with its stone façade, high ceilings and tall sash windows

facts.text: James Craig Walk has a private entrance and a dedicated W Insider concierge service.
facts.excerpt: Discover a private entrance, your own dedicated W Insider concierge service

facts.text: The rooftop W Deck offers 360-degree panoramic views of Edinburgh.
facts.excerpt: Rise to the rooftop and discover the 360 degree W Deck offering panoramic vistas of Scotland’s capital.

facts.text: Many of the premium suites, from Premier Suites to the W Suite and Penthouse, have private terraces with views of the city.
facts.excerpt: From our Premier Suites to our W Suite and Penthouse, many of our premium suites offer private terraces with incredible views of Scotland’s capital.

facts.text: The Penthouse on the 9th floor of the Ribbon building has a modern fireplace, a spacious dining room and a rock bar inspired by the city's volcanic beginnings.
facts.excerpt: the Penthouse is located on the 9th floor of the Ribbon building, offering an expansive living area with a modern fire place, spacious dining room and unique rock bar inspired by the city’s volcanic beginnings

facts.text: The Penthouse has a private sauna and an outdoor shower on its private terrace with views of Edinburgh Castle.
facts.excerpt: Our Penthouse features your very own private sauna. Benefit from the healing powers of the heat or if cooler temperatures are your thing - step into the outside shower on the private terrace for fresh air and views of Edinburgh Castle

facts.text: Suites have Georgian-style panelling, saltire-inspired wood flooring and artwork by Scottish photographer Jodie Mann.
facts.excerpt: Modern design features include Georgian style panelling and saltire inspired wood flooring as well as daring artwork by Scottish photographer Jodie Mann

facts.text: The W Suites have a round super-king-sized bed.
facts.excerpt: In the bedroom you’ll find a unique round super-king sized bed

facts.text: Castle View rooms look out over the historic landscape of Edinburgh.
facts.excerpt: Book one of our Castle View rooms to enjoy the historic landscape of the city of Edinburgh.

facts.text: AWAY Spa's treatment rooms are named Fire, Earth, Water and Air, and a double treatment room hosts couples retreats.
facts.excerpt: Relax and unwind in one of four treatment rooms of our hotel spa in Edinburgh; Fire, Earth, Water and Air. Or indulge in a couples retreat or experience day in our double treatment room.

facts.text: The Sound Suite is a space for music creation, recording sessions and cultural takeovers.
facts.excerpt: Creativity continues in the Sound Suite, with recording sessions, cultural takeovers

facts.text: Sunset Sessions in the W Lounge feature DJs as day turns to night.
facts.excerpt: From Sunset Sessions in the W Lounge, where DJs set the tempo as day turns to night

facts.text: SUSHISAMBA serves Japanese, Brazilian and Peruvian cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Discover Japanese, Brazilian and Peruvian cuisine at our SUSHISAMBA restaurant in Edinburgh city centre.

facts.text: Joao's Place is an intimate cocktail bar with Brazilian-inspired small bites and drinks.
facts.excerpt: with Brazilian-inspired small bites and drinks

facts.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
facts.excerpt: Minimum Age to Check In: 18

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: Pets Not Allowed

facts.text: On-site parking is operated by St James Quarter, not by the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Though there is on-site parking, it is not operated by the hotel, it is operated by St James Quarter.

facts.text: Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
facts.excerpt: No, the rooms at W Edinburgh do not permit rollaway beds.

facts.text: Edinburgh Airport is about 7.8 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: EDI is located approximately 7.8 KM from the hotel.
